brief: The canvas displays a sweeping arid landscape dominated by deep terracotta earth, richly textured with visible cracks and fissures. The stark, beige sky hangs above, sharply contrasting with the ground below, which is minimally populated by sparse acacia trees. Subtle dust devils drift across the expanse, sometimes gathering into larger, organized swirling patterns near the horizon line, where a pronounced distant rock formation anchors the scene. The overall feeling is one of vast, dry silence, punctuated only by the ceaseless, subtle movement of dust and the play of light across the cracked earth.

statement: This sketch renders a sweeping arid landscape with deep terracotta earth and cracked textures, under a stark beige sky. The scene features sparse acacia trees and subtle dust devils that drift across the terrain. Through careful layering of procedural elements—cracked terrain, rock formations, tree placements, and animated dust particles—the work captures the feeling of vast dry silence punctuated by gentle, ceaseless motion. The composition emphasizes minimalism and texture over complexity, using p5.js's drawing capabilities to create an immersive yet restrained desert environment that evolves subtly over time without user interaction.
